units.source_text: 在内藏助来看来，谈话的走势又开始偏离轨道了，

en.t: From Kuranosuke's point of view, the conversation had begun to drift off course again,

units.source_text: 因此他故意煞有其事的说了几句谦卑的话，想借此巧妙地转换话题。

en.t: So he deliberately made a few solemn-sounding humble remarks, hoping to use them to shift the subject deftly.
